keyword: how to choose a concrete mixer pump

title.en: How to Choose a Mixer Pump: Electric or Diesel, from Xingtai
title.zh: 如何在邢台目录里选电动或柴油搅拌泵

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists two mixer pumps that mix and pump on one trailer. They are not mixing plants. Match the power cell and the stone-distance row, then inquire.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台列出两台在同一拖车上搅拌并泵送的搅拌泵。它们不是搅拌站。对照动力格子和石子距离行后再询盘。

h1.en: Choose the Electric Mixer or the Diesel Mixer
h1.zh: 选择电动搅拌泵或柴油搅拌泵

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai publishes two mixer pumps and no mixing plant. The electric integrated mixer prints a 45 kW main motor plus a 14 kW mixer motor, 21 m³/h and one distance pair, 100 m / 300 m. The diesel mixer prints a 4108 engine at 66–75 kW, 25 m³/h, and three stone-distance rows. Choose the page that matches whether the site can feed those two motors or must use diesel, then inquire. There is no printed price.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台）公布两台搅拌泵，没有搅拌站。电动搅拌泵一体机印主电机 45 kW 加搅拌电机 14 kW、21 m³/h，以及一组距离 100 m / 300 m。柴油搅拌泵印 4108 发动机 66–75 kW、25 m³/h，以及三行石子距离。现场能供给这两台电机就选电动页，必须用柴油就选柴油页，然后询盘。没有印出的价格。

body.en: Open [/en/products/mixer-pumps/](/en/products/mixer-pumps/), then [/en/products/integrated-mixer-pump/](/en/products/integrated-mixer-pump/) or [/en/products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump/](/en/products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump/). A pump-only trailer such as Electric 40 does not list a mixer motor.
body.zh: 先打开 [/zh/products/mixer-pumps/](/zh/products/mixer-pumps/)，再进 [/zh/products/integrated-mixer-pump/](/zh/products/integrated-mixer-pump/) 或 [/zh/products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump/](/zh/products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump/)。电动40这类只泵送的拖泵没有搅拌电机格子。

heading.en: What is different on the diesel mixer sheet?
heading.zh: 柴油搅拌泵页有什么不同？

body.en: The diesel mixer prints three distance rows: stone up to 1 inch at 100 / 300 m, 13 mm stone at 60 / 180 m, and 24 mm stone at 40 / 120 m. The electric mixer prints one pair, 100 m / 300 m, and aggregate 4 cm and below. Write the stone size you will load so Xingtai can see which row you mean.
body.zh: 柴油搅拌泵印三行距离：1 英寸以内石子 100 / 300 m，13 mm 石子 60 / 180 m，24 mm 石子 40 / 120 m。电动搅拌泵只印一组 100 m / 300 m，骨料 4 cm 及以下。把你要装的石子粒径写上，邢台才知道你指的是哪一行。

heading.en: What should the order not say?

body.en: Do not call either machine a batching plant. Do not copy Electric 40’s 45 kW onto the mixer and drop the 14 kW mixer motor. Both mixer pages print hopper 0.4 m³. Weights differ: 4500 kg electric, 4200 kg diesel. Ask for the price at [/en/contact/](/en/contact/).
body.zh: 不要把这两台叫成搅拌站。不要只抄电动40的 45 kW 而丢掉搅拌电机 14 kW。两台搅拌泵的料斗都是 0.4 m³。重量不同：电动 4500 kg，柴油 4200 kg。价格问 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。

question.en: Is a mixer pump a mixing plant?

answer.en: No. Hebei Pinjin Machinery states that mixing plants are not catalogue products. These two machines mix and pump on one trailer.
answer.zh: 不是。河北品锦机械写明搅拌站不是目录产品。这两台是在同一拖车上搅拌并泵送。

question.en: Why quote two kilowatt numbers on the electric mixer?
question.zh: 为什么电动搅拌泵要报两个千瓦？

answer.en: The sheet prints 45 kW for the main motor and 14 kW for the mixer motor. An inquiry that names only 45 kW is incomplete.
answer.zh: 该页印主电机 45 kW、搅拌电机 14 kW。只写 45 kW 的询盘是不完整的。

question.en: Which mixer page has three stone rows?
question.zh: 哪一页有三行石子距离？

answer.en: The diesel mixer. The electric mixer has a single 100 m / 300 m pair.
answer.zh: 柴油搅拌泵。电动搅拌泵只有一组 100 m / 300 m。

question.en: Is the price on the mixer hub?
question.zh: 搅拌泵分类页有价格吗？

answer.en: No. Xingtai confirms the price after inquiry.
answer.zh: 没有。邢台在询盘后确认价格。
